channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mario Hezonja | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mario Hezonja from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Mario Hezonja, Peyton Watson, Jaylon Tyson
item.description:
Donovan Mitchell:

“The biggest thing is our length, our versatility. Adding a guy like Peyton Watson changes us in a major way. Obviously you have Jaylon Tyson on the perimeter as well, even Mario Hezonja. Just our size, our athleticism, being able to implement different coverages, different schemes, I think will definitely be able to help us come down the stretch. Not be so one track minded defensively and obviously having Evan and Jaylen, they do their thing back there for us as always and they lead us. But I think with the addition of Peyton and Tyson, I think those two are going to elevate us from the perimeter spot.”

Donovan Mitchell on Mario Hezonja, Peyton Watson, Jaylon Tyson, Oct 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Myles Turner on Mario Hezonja
item.description:
“I thought I was going number 5 to Orlando. My agent said ‘We’re going number 5 to Orlando, this is it, you had a great workout there, they’re excited about you.’I was ‘All right, cool.’ I’m at the table in the greenroom… ‘With the number 5 pick, the Orlando Magic select Mario Hezonja.’ I’m like, ‘Who the f*ck is this?'”

Myles Turner on Mario Hezonja, Sep 13, 2023. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Pau Gasol on Mario Hezonja
item.description:
Pau Gasol:

“It has changed a lot. For me, the big change is the game itself. There are very fast shots, very short possessions, few passes in each attack. There are many hasty shots. When I was younger, some of the shots that are attempted today would have seen the coach send you to the bench as a punishment. Now it is encouraged to shoot in the first eight seconds of possession. It has lost the beauty of the game, the purity it had, the fact of moving the ball from one side to the other, the ball inside-outside, which was to play with two in the post. Now there are times when there are teams that play with five small guys. [Mario] Hezonja played the other day as centre with us.”

Pau Gasol on Mario Hezonja, Nov 3, 2019. Source: Marca.com.

item.title: David Fizdale on Mario Hezonja
item.description:
Barbara Barker:Fizdale on Mario Hezonja:

“Serious competitor. His work ethic has been fantastic.... He brings a lot of skills to the game. Just a matter of harnessing it.”

David Fizdale on Mario Hezonja, Nov 11, 2018. Source: Twitter @meanbarb.

item.title: Scott Perry on Mario Hezonja
item.description:
Knicks general manager Scott Perry on Mario Hezonja:

“With Mario, we’re adding another young, athletic and driven player. We’re confident he will further develop under this coaching staff and excel playing in New York.”

Scott Perry on Mario Hezonja, Jul 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Joan Creus on Mario Hezonja
item.description:
FC Barcelona manager Joan Creus hopes to keep Mario Hezonja but he knows it will be difficult for the Spanish champions to compete with the NBA.

“Mario Hezonja? When NBA calls you can’t do a lot because of the financial power of the NBA. We hope to keep Mario Hezonja for next years. I am sure his future will depend on the position he’ll be selected in the next NBA draft”

Joan Creus on Mario Hezonja, Feb 24, 2015. Source: Sportando.
